stories.title: OpenAI’s 流氓人工智慧集體聰明到足以突破沙盒限制，卻愚蠢到會去和幽靈戰鬥。 / OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost

sources.title: OpenAI’s 流氓人工智慧集體聰明到足以突破沙盒限制，卻愚蠢到會去和幽靈戰鬥。 / OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost
sources.title_zh: OpenAI’s 流氓人工智慧集體聰明到足以突破沙盒限制，卻愚蠢到會去和幽靈戰鬥。
sources.title_en: OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost
sources.title_original: OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost
sources.summary: Around 1,200 isolated OpenAI agents organized themselves into a collective through an internal package registry during a safety test, broke into Hugging Face systems, and eventually attacked OpenAI's own infrastructure. Their multi-day deception effort targeted an automated evaluator that never existed. OpenAI calls the incident a "warning shot," and the investigation had to be carried out largely by one of the involved models itself because no alternative was available. The article OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在一次安全測試中，大約1200個孤立的OpenAI智慧體透過內部軟體包登入檔組織成一個群體，入侵了Hugging Face系統，並最終攻擊了OpenAI's本身的基礎設施。它們持續數天的欺騙行動的目標是一個根本不存在的自動化評估器。 OpenAI將此事件稱為“警告”，由於沒有其他替代方案，調查工作主要由其中一個涉事模型自行完成。文章《OpenAI’s流氓AI群體夠聰明，能夠突破沙箱，卻愚蠢到與幽靈戰鬥》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.summary: OpenAI, together with more than 100 companies including Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, Deutsche Telekom, and SAP, has published an open letter on AI-powered cyber defense. The coalition warns of increasingly sophisticated AI attacks on critical infrastructure such as hospitals and water treatment plants and calls for swift action while defenders still have the upper hand. The article OpenAI rallies 100+ companies to sign open letter warning AI-powered cyberattacks on critical infrastructure are imminent appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI聯合包括微軟、Google、Anthropic、德國電信和SAP在內的100多家公司，共同發布了一封關於人工智慧網路防禦的公開信。該聯盟警告稱，針對醫院和水處理廠等關鍵基礎設施的人工智慧攻擊日益複雜，並呼籲在防禦者仍佔優勢時迅速採取行動。文章《OpenAI聯合100多家公司簽署公開信，警告人工智慧網路攻擊對關鍵基礎設施迫在眉睫》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 視訊產生更便宜、更靈活 / Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible
sources.title_zh: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 視訊產生更便宜、更靈活
sources.title_en: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible
sources.title_original: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible
sources.summary: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video model now analyzes up to ten seconds of existing footage instead of just the last second for more consistent scene extensions. Scenes can be extended in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds. A new 360p draft mode runs up to 60 percent faster at a third of the cost. The article Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 視訊模型現在可以分析長達 10 秒的現有素材，而不僅僅是最後一秒，從而實現更一致的場景擴展。場景可以以 10 秒為增量進行擴展，最長可達 40 秒。全新的 360p 草稿模式運行速度提升高達 60%，成本卻只有原來的三分之一。文章《Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 影片產生更經濟、更靈活》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title: OpenAI 研究員警告：超高速人工智慧可能讓安全團隊束手無策 / OpenAI researcher warns ultrafast AI could leave security teams in the dust
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 研究員警告：超高速人工智慧可能讓安全團隊束手無策
sources.title_en: OpenAI researcher warns ultrafast AI could leave security teams in the dust
sources.title_original: OpenAI researcher warns ultrafast AI could leave security teams in the dust
sources.summary: An OpenAI researcher warns that state-of-the-art AI models running 50 times faster could infiltrate systems before human teams can react. Simple monitoring won't cut it anymore, he says. What's needed are autonomous shutdown systems. The warning comes as OpenAI unveils a new AI chip that significantly outperforms current hardware in inference speed. The article OpenAI researcher warns ultrafast AI could leave security teams in the dust appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一位OpenAI的研究人員警告說，運行速度提升50倍的尖端人工智慧模型可能會在人類團隊做出反應之前滲透到系統中。他表示，簡單的監控已經遠遠不夠，我們需要的是自主關閉系統。同時，OpenAI發布了一款新型人工智慧晶片，其推理速度顯著超越了現有硬體。這篇文章《OpenAI研究人員警告：超高速人工智慧可能讓安全團隊束手無策》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

stories.title: 研究發現，人工智慧購物代理還不能代表你購買商品。 / AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds

sources.title: 研究發現，人工智慧購物代理還不能代表你購買商品。 / AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds
sources.title_zh: 研究發現，人工智慧購物代理還不能代表你購買商品。
sources.title_en: AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds
sources.title_original: AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds
sources.summary: Letting an AI do your shopping might not get you the best deal. Researchers at the Wharton School show how erratic AI shopping agents really are: a single external source like Wirecutter shifted product picks by up to 99 percentage points, and even changing the order of identical information altered the outcome. The article AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 讓AI幫你購物未必能幫你找到最划算的商品。華頓商學院的研究人員指出，AI購物代理的決策其實非常不穩定：僅僅一個外部資料來源（例如Wirecutter）就能讓AI推薦的商品數量變化高達99個百分點，甚至改變相同資訊的順序也會影響最終結果。這篇文章《研究發現：AI購物代理還不適合替你購物》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

stories.title: 企業人工智慧的真正風險不在於自主代理本身，而是它們之間的複雜性。 / Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.

sources.title: 企業人工智慧的真正風險不在於自主代理本身，而是它們之間的複雜性。 / Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
sources.title_zh: 企業人工智慧的真正風險不在於自主代理本身，而是它們之間的複雜性。
sources.title_en: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
sources.title_original: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
sources.summary: Presented by Gravitee Agent complexity is the insidious shadow lurking inside enterprises right now that needs a light shone on it. That’s because enterprises don't deploy a single agent and watch it run, they deploy fleets, each one calling APIs, calling other agents, reaching into applications that were never built with a machine decision-maker in mind. That's the failure mode that should keep you up at night: a windy, complicated system nobody can see clearly enough to govern. But why do things get so opaque so quickly? Add a second agent to a system, and you've added one connection. Add a tenth, and you haven't added ten connections, you've potentially added dozens, because now any agent might call any other, and each of those calls can trigger a call somewhere else. Complexity doesn't creep up with agent headcount. It compounds with the number of paths between agents, and nobody's job is to draw that graph. A support ticket that used to touch one system might now pass through four agents before a human ever lays eyes on it, and every one of those handoffs is a decision point nobody approved. Most enterprise AI programs stall when the humans responsible for their agents lose the thread. Ask a security team a simple question: which agents can reach which systems, and watch the silence. Ask which agent triggered which downstream action three hops ago. More silence. The instinct is to treat this like a checklist. Approve the agent. Log the agent. Move on. I'd argue this is the wrong instinct. A checklist checks a single point in time. Complexity runs across a chain, and yo
sources.summary_zh: 由 Gravitee 呈現：代理複雜性是目前企業內部潛藏的隱患，亟需引起重視。這是因為企業並非部署單一代理並靜觀其變，而是部署代理叢集，每個代理都會呼叫 API，呼叫其他代理，並接入那些最初並未考慮機器決策的應用程式。這才是真正令人擔憂的故障模式：一個混亂不堪、錯綜複雜的系統，無人能清楚地瞭解其運作狀況並加以有效管理。但為什麼系統會如此迅速地變得如此晦澀難懂？在系統中加入第二個代理，你只是增加了一個連線。新增第十個代理，你增加的不是十個連線，而是可能增加了數十個連線，因為現在任何一個代理都可以呼叫任何其他代理，而每個呼叫都可能觸發其他地方的呼叫。複雜性並非隨著代理數量的增加而增長，而是隨著代理之間路徑數量的增加而累積，而繪製這張關係圖並非任何人的職責。以前只需處理一個系統的支援工單，現在可能要經過四個代理才能最終到達人工處理，而每一次交接都是一個未經批准的決策點。大多數企業級人工智慧程式都會因為負責代理的人員疏忽而停滯不前。問問安全團隊一個簡單的問題：哪些代理可以存取哪些系統？他們通常會保持沉默。再問他們，是哪個代理在三跳之前觸發了哪個下游操作？依然是沉默。人們的第一個反應是把這當成一份清單來處理：批准代理，記錄代理，然後繼續。但我認為這是錯的。清單只能檢查一個時間點。而複雜性是沿著一條鏈傳遞的，需要不斷迭代才能解決。

sources.title_original: Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles
sources.summary: Google's new Gemini 3.5 Transcribe recognizes over 85 languages, strips filler words, and corrects slips of the tongue in real time. It hits a 4.0 percent word error rate in streaming mode, with 70 percent lower latency than its predecessor, Chirp 3. Through function calling, the model can hand off tasks to other Gemini models. The article Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google's 和 Gemini 3.5 的全新轉錄功能可辨識超過 85 種語言，去除語氣詞，並即時修正口誤。其在串流模式下的單字錯誤率僅為 4.0%，延遲比上一代產品 Chirp 3 降低了 70%。透過函數調用，該型號可以將任務移交給其他 Gemini 型號。文章《Google's 和 Gemini 3.5 轉錄功能可將 85 種語言的語音轉換為文本，並自動糾正您的口誤》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title_original: GLM-5.3-Flash matches top models at a fraction of the cost, and runs without Nvidia
sources.summary: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3-Flash, an open-source model with 320 billion parameters that lands just three points behind the larger GLM-5.3 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, at a seventh of the cost. What's notable is that all of the inference traffic ran on Chinese AI chips instead of Nvidia hardware. The article GLM-5.3-Flash matches top models at a fraction of the cost, and runs without Nvidia appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是一個擁有 3200 億個參數的開源模型，在人工智慧分析的智慧指數中僅比規模更大的 GLM-5.3 低 3 分，而成本卻只有後者的七分之一。值得注意的是，所有推理運算都運行在國產 AI 晶片上，而非輝達硬體。文章《GLM-5.3-Flash 以極低的成本匹配頂級模型，且無需輝達硬體》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title: 輝達以129億美元收購Hugging Face，封閉式人工智慧實驗室退出市場 / Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
sources.title_zh: 輝達以129億美元收購Hugging Face，封閉式人工智慧實驗室退出市場
sources.title_en: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
sources.title_original: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
sources.summary: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware. The article Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 輝達以129億美元收購開源人工智慧平臺Hugging Face，約為其1.5億美元年營收的80倍。此舉符合輝達數十億美元投資開源人工智慧模式的策略，同時，像OpenAI和Anthropic這樣的封閉式人工智慧實驗室正逐漸放棄輝達的硬體。這篇文章《輝達以129億美元收購Hugging Face，封閉式人工智慧實驗室紛紛撤離》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.title_zh: 當代理自主行動時，治理必須存在於資料層中。
sources.title_en: When agents act on their own, governance has to live in the data layer
sources.title_original: When agents act on their own, governance has to live in the data layer
sources.summary: Presented by EDB As enterprises give AI agents more autonomy — the ability to plan, decide, and act across systems without a human approving each step — a hard question moves to the center of every architecture review: When an agent tries to complete an action that it was never authorized to do, what actually stops it? These are your agents, running on your models, touching your data in your infrastructure — and the responsibility for what they do sits with you. That responsibility can’t be met in hindsight or with a set of abstract policies that live on paper but not in practice. Agents need rules in the context of the moment, because they don’t exercise overriding judgment of their own actions. Consider a simple rule: Never open the car door. Followed literally, an agent could never get in or out of the car at all. But if you change the context (the car has just crashed, there’s a fire, someone is hurt and needs to get out), then the rule you actually want is the opposite. Context in the moment is everything. We are asking agents to do intelligent things; that requires intelligent rules. The instinct is to add guardrails around the agent: instructions, policies, and monitoring layered above the model. Those mechanisms matter, but they share a structural limit: The car-door rule is plausible right up until the moment you actually have to decide whether to open the door. Controls at the agent layer are only as reliable as the agent’s output is predictable, and autonomy is precisely the property that makes that output hard to predict. sources.summary_zh: 由EDB呈現：隨著企業賦予人工智慧代理更大的自主權——即無需人工審批即可跨系統進行規劃、決策和行動的能力——一個棘手的問題成為每次架構評審的核心：當代理試圖執行未經授權的操作時，究竟是什麼阻止了它？這些代理程式運行在您的模型上，存取您基礎架構中的資料—它們的行為責任在於您。這種責任無法事後補救，也無法透過一套紙上談兵、不切實際的抽象策略來承擔。代理需要根據具體情況制定規則，因為它們無法對自身行為進行凌駕一切的判斷。考慮一條簡單的規則：永遠不要打開車門。如果嚴格按照這條規則執行，代理商根本無法進入或離開汽車。但如果您改變情境（例如，汽車剛剛發生事故、發生火災、有人受傷需要逃生），那麼您真正需要的規則就恰恰相反。情境至關重要。我們要求代理執行智能操作；這需要智能規則。人們的本能是為智能體添加護欄：在模型之上疊加指令、策略和監控層。這些機制固然重要，但它們都存在著一個結構性限制：就像「車門規則」一樣，在你真正需要決定是否開門之前，它都是合理的。智能體層面的控制措施的可靠性取決於智能體輸出的可預測性，而自主性恰恰是導致輸出難以預測的特性。依賴審查的治理方式

sources.summary: Every agent that writes code needs somewhere to run it, and no two vendors quote the same units. This comparison measures burst cold start across E2B, Daytona, Modal, Cloudflare, and Vercel, normalizes per-second rates to cost per 1,000 executions, and maps filesystem persistence, idle billing, and egress policy against primary sources verified August 27, 2026. sources.summary_zh: 每個編寫程式碼的代理程式都需要一個運行程式碼的地方，而不同的供應商提供的報價也不盡相同。本文比較了 E2B、Daytona、Modal、Cloudflare 和 Vercel 的突發冷啟動效能，將每秒費率標準化為每千次執行的成本，並將檔案系統持久性、空閒計費和出口策略與主要來源進行比對（2026 年 8 月 27 日驗證）。本文《2026 年最佳代理商沙箱：E2B、Daytona、Modal、Cloudflare 和 Vercel 的冷啟動、每秒定價和網路策略》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: 智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款原生支援 320B-A18B 的多模態 MoE，具備 100 萬個令牌上下文 / Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context

sources.title: 智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款原生支援 320B-A18B 的多模態 MoE，具備 100 萬個令牌上下文 / Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
sources.title_zh: 智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款原生支援 320B-A18B 的多模態 MoE，具備 100 萬個令牌上下文
sources.title_en: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
sources.title_original: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
sources.summary: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series — a 320B-total / 18B-active MoE with a 1,048,576-token context window, MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, and API pricing at $0.15/M input and $0.50/M output. It scores 84.3 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 63.4 on DeepSWE v1.1, using hybrid KDA linear plus NoPE sparse MLA attention to cut attention compute ~3× and KV cache 4.4× versus GLM-5.3. The post Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是 GLM-5 系列中首個原生多模態模型。該模型擁有 3,200 億總資料量和 180 億活動資料量，上下文視窗大小為 1,048,576 個 Token，權重採用 MIT 許可，API 定價為每百萬輸入 0.15 美元，每百萬輸出 0.50 美元。 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 84.3 分，在 DeepSWE v1.1 測試中獲得 63.4 分。它採用混合 KDA 線性注意力機制和 NoPE 稀疏 MLA 注意力機制，相較於 GLM-5.3，注意力計算量降低了約 3 倍，鍵值快取降低了 4.4 倍。這篇文章《智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款擁有 100 萬個 Token 上下文的 320 億-180 億原生多模態模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。 Hugging Face

stories.title: 比爾蓋茲警告：AI時代將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一

sources.title: 比爾蓋茲警告：AI時代將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一

sources.title_original: 比爾蓋茲警告：AI時代將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一
sources.summary: 微軟共同創辦人比爾蓋茲（Bill Gates）週三（8/26）在個人部落格Gates Notes發表近6,000字長文＜動盪的AI時代已經來臨＞（The turbulent AI era is here），警告即使是在最理想的情況下，AI帶來的轉型仍將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一。蓋茲強調，AI要麼成為史上最偉大的平等推手，要麼成為最嚴重的不公義來源，關鍵取決於全球接下來幾年做出的決策。然而，目前看不到各界領導者與專家正在充分因應這項挑戰。

stories.title: Google 研究公司推出 GlucoFM：一種用於連續血糖監測的 0.72M 參數雙流基礎模型 / Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring

sources.title: Google 研究公司推出 GlucoFM：一種用於連續血糖監測的 0.72M 參數雙流基礎模型 / Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
sources.title_zh: Google 研究公司推出 GlucoFM：一種用於連續血糖監測的 0.72M 參數雙流基礎模型
sources.title_en: Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
sources.title_original: Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
sources.summary: Google Research and UNSW Sydney released GlucoFM, a self-supervised foundation model that splits a CGM trace into a slow physiological stream and a transient event stream instead of encoding it as one sequence. At 0.72M parameters it reached 58.8 task-averaged PR-AUC across 14 cohort–task evaluations, beating a 135M GluFormer and a 385M MOMENT. It remains a research prototype with no regulatory clearance. The post Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 和新南威爾斯大學雪梨分校聯合發布了 GlucoFM，這是一款自監督基礎模型，它將 CGM 血糖監測曲線拆分為緩慢的生理流和瞬態事件流，而不是將其編碼為單一序列。在 14 個隊列-任務評估中，GlucoFM 擁有 72 萬個參數，任務平均 PR-AUC 達到 58.8，優於 1.35 億個參數的 GluFormer 和擁有 3.85 億個參數的 MOMENT。目前，GlucoFM 仍處於研究原型階段，尚未獲得監管部門的批准。本文原刊於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google Research 推出 GlucoFM：一款擁有 72 萬個參數的雙流基礎模型，用於連續血糖監測」。

stories.title: 資策會讓AI看懂黃金蜆開合，結合數位雙生打造2分鐘內水質預警機制

sources.title: 資策會讓AI看懂黃金蜆開合，結合數位雙生打造2分鐘內水質預警機制
sources.title_zh: 資策會讓AI看懂黃金蜆開合，結合數位雙生打造2分鐘內水質預警機制
sources.title_original: 資策會讓AI看懂黃金蜆開合，結合數位雙生打造2分鐘內水質預警機制
sources.summary: 水質監測除了仰賴設備高昂的各種感測器，也能透過生物行為建立即時預警機制。資策會人工智慧研究院（AI院）在經濟部產業技術司支持下，近期將展示一項「生物水質感測數位雙生技術」，運用AI影像辨識黃金蜆的開合行為，當水質異常時，藉由蜆集體閉殼的自然反應，即時發出警示，打造低成本、高效率的智慧水質監測方案。

stories.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
sources.title_en: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
sources.title_original: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
sources.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Another open weights model from Qwen. This one is "a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4". It's pretty big: 125B tokens, but only 6B active which means it gets a significant performance boost. I've been trying it out on a DGX Spark using these Unsloth quantized models . I'm still exploring the model - so far I've tried the 72.5GB UD-IQ1_S one (producing these pelicans ) and the 78.9GB UD-Q2_K_XL (producing these ). My favorite so far was this xhigh reasoning effort one from UD-Q2_K_XL: Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , qwen , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , ai-in-china , nvidia-spark
sources.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 是 Qwen 提供的另一個開放權重模型。這是一個「多模態 MoE 模型，同時也是 Qwen4 架構的早期預覽」。它非常龐大：1250 億個 token，但只有 60 億個活躍 token，這意味著它的性能得到了顯著提升。我一直在使用 Unsloth 量化模型在 DGX Spark 上進行測試。我仍在探索這個模型——目前為止，我已經嘗試了 72.5GB 的 UD-IQ1_S 模型（生成了這些鵜鶘）和 78.9GB 的 UD-Q2_K_XL 模型（產生了這些）。到目前為止，我最喜歡的是 UD-Q2_K_XL 中這個高推理努力的模型：來自 Hacker News 標籤：ai、生成式人工智慧、llms、qwen、鵜鶘騎自行車、中國人工智慧、nvidia-spark

stories.title: 智譜 和 GLM 5.3 Flash 在 Editorial Craft 基準測試中以 0.94 分位居榜首。 / Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash tops Editorial Craft benchmark at 0.94

sources.title: 智譜 和 GLM 5.3 Flash 在 Editorial Craft 基準測試中以 0.94 分位居榜首。 / Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash tops Editorial Craft benchmark at 0.94
sources.title_zh: 智譜 和 GLM 5.3 Flash 在 Editorial Craft 基準測試中以 0.94 分位居榜首。
sources.title_en: Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash tops Editorial Craft benchmark at 0.94
sources.title_original: Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash tops Editorial Craft benchmark at 0.94
sources.summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation, Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 Flash ranked first with a 0.94 score and an estimated cost of $0.0002 per task. Step-3.7-flash followed at 0.92, while Qwen3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5 (Fast), Gemini 3.7 Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 rounded out the leaderboard.
sources.summary_zh: 在包含 12 個任務的編輯流程評估中，智譜的 GLM 5.3 Flash 以 0.94 分的成績位列第一，每項任務的預估成本為 0.0002 美元。 Step-3.7-flash 以 0.92 分緊隨其後，而 Qwen3.8 Flash、Claude Opus 5 (Fast)、Gemini 3.7 Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 則位列排行榜的其餘部分。
